plan: At price $39 equal to my value, staying in risks negative profit if I win at this or higher price. Dropping out guarantees $0 profit, which is better than a potential loss. No reason to continue bidding above my value.

Next price ($34.0) exceeds my value ($34), which would guarantee a loss if I win at that price. Staying in at $33.5 is still fine, but I should drop before price exceeds my value. Since $34.0 >= value, I should drop now.
At $45, my value equals the price, so profit would be $0 if I win now. Continuing to $45.5 risks negative profit if I win, with no upside since price can't exceed my value. Best to drop out.
